test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

The young girl is very __audacious__ in every activity.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Timid**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Audacious **means bold and daring. (निर्भीक और साहसी)

 
 
• **For example- ***Her audacious plan surprised everyone at the meeting.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Timid **means shy and lacking in confidence, which is the **opposite **of '
